details:
I'm a live anchor and I'm having a lot of trouble with vrcaht
When using VR to capture the game screen in the desktop window via OBS, the viewer's senses are very shaky and even create vertigo. Only by opening the game in the camera to capture a more stable picture, but also generated the need to operate frequently to adjust the camera trouble. This is very unfavorable for the live game VRCHAT, expect to get the following functional improvements.
1. open the camera when using VR, hope to add a third-person camera follow, similar to the perspective of GTA, easy for viewers to see the direction the player is currently facing, with whom to talk, intelligent adjustment of the angle, so that the camera is more like a drone perspective will follow. Hope the camera capture screen, can display the player's ID.
2. When using VR to open the camera capture, I hope to have picture-in-picture mode, you can see the camera screen at the desktop, and also have a small screen of the first perspective. Or the current frontal model screen of yourself.
3. I hope to allow players to declare whether the model contains NSFW elements, or political and religious satire elements. In the anchor mode or children's mode can choose to block the corresponding elements, in order to comply with local laws and regulations, and political and religious beliefs. The blocked counterpart will turn on the alternate model. If a model is reported by 50 players or 100 players, for having NSFW or religious-political elements. TAG will be added to the model forcibly.
4. We hope to add in the SDK that when the map author designs the map, he can install several predefined camera positions in the game, and when the player starts the camera in the game, he will be prompted that the author has pre-made several special camera positions for you, which can be immediately adapted to the coordinates. The purpose of this feature is that there are some maps that have some game locations among them, party locations, and when you live in these locations, you need to match the camera locations frequently every time.
5. hope to add a new video player, for China [BILIBILI] video support, after verification [BILIBILI] video content after parsing .mp4 address is playable in the existing VRchat player, non-copyright video, most of the world can be played normally. But there are two problems. 1. the source address can not be played, you need to extract the MP4 through third-party tools, 2. the URL of the extracted MP4 address is too long you need to shorten the URL address through third-party services to play properly.
6. UI interface needs Chinese translation
7. Chinese players in the game player to watch youtube videos, occasionally there will be VPN can not be correctly resolved video address, resulting in lag and can not play (in China youtube is blocked, you need to use VPN to watch) (VRCHAT in the same time can not be resolved, using Chrome browser can play youtube and very (smooth)
title: For live broadcast anchors Camera functionality improvement
